title: 120 in-game turns were consumed by thorough-but-not-exhaustive exploration of the Vale plus reaching and starting the Hollow King decision; the fight with the king (8/12 hp) was still open when the budget ran out, and the game had already signaled a much larger Act 2 ('six holds') ahead. No pacing signal warns the player they are behind the turn budget.
